purpose: Keep simple supporting/reference images and evidence-review holds out of the public THC Infographic Library and all infographic topic-page reuse.
notes: PDF page extractions are source/recovery material, not standalone infographics.
THC-ENC-001 VIS images are supporting encyclopedia/reference visuals, not infographic-library entries.
V04-SUP images are supplemental lesson visuals, not infographic-library entries.
THC-ENC-004 supporting assets 01, 02, 04, and 05 are reference panels. Asset 03 is explicitly a finished infographic and remains eligible.
Files prefixed quarantine- are retained as source assets while scientific claims are corrected; they must not publish to infographic surfaces.
WebP source files remain reference-only until converted to a WordPress-safe PNG or JPEG canonical asset.
HARV-01 is temporarily withheld because its trichome-color language overstates peak THC, CBN formation, and predicted effects.
HARV-02 is temporarily withheld because exact cloudy/amber ratios and effect predictions are not established universal harvest targets.
HARV-04 is temporarily withheld because cannabis-specific evidence does not support presenting bud-washing recipes as validated remediation for mold, pesticides, or microbial contamination.
Other THC-ENC educational panels are not blanket-excluded; they remain eligible unless specifically classified as a simple supporting image in this manifest.
